for.description: ID of the rich tooltip's external trigger in the same document or shadow tree.

heading.description: Rich tooltip heading. Pair it with `for` and optional direct text in the default slot.

label.description:
The entire plain tooltip content. The string is reflected to the slotted
trigger's accessible description without changing its name. Empty or
whitespace-only labels render no tooltip and expose no description.
When to use: a short hint that clarifies the slotted trigger.
When NOT to use: never use `label` for essential information, rich
content, interactive content, validation messages, or information attached
to disabled controls; put that content in visible UI or a popover.

placement.description:
Preferred placement for the tooltip. The component may flip or clamp the
rendered placement to keep the bubble inside the viewport; unknown runtime
values fall back to `top`.
When NOT to use: do not depend on placement for meaning or reading order.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-effect-component-secondary-default-.description: MarsUI Component_effect/secondary_default: drop 0/2/1.5/-0.5 plus inner White/3 0/2/3. Pair with --ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter.

--ki-motion-distance-sm.description: Motion travel distance sm (4px): small slide/settle offsets.

--ki-motion-duration-instant.description: Zero-duration step: transitions that must complete immediately (reduced-motion fallbacks, instant handoffs).

--ki-motion-easing-standard-accelerate.description: Utility exit curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.standard-accelerate. onmars: the MarsUI accelerate curve (ki.easing.in).

--ki-surface-image-tooltip-arrow-end.description: End-edge arrow color for a themed tooltip surface.

--ki-surface-image-tooltip-arrow-start.description: Start-edge arrow color for a themed tooltip surface.

--ki-tooltip-arrow-radius.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for the rounding of the arrow tip (Tooltip master pointer: 1.5px, nearest radius step).

--ki-tooltip-arrow-size.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for the depth of the arrow that points at the trigger; it is twice as wide (Tooltip master 12089:7621 pointer: 16x8). Zero removes it. Equal to offset, so the tip meets the trigger.

--ki-tooltip-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter behind the tooltip bubble.

--ki-tooltip-bg.description: Base background color of the tooltip. Onmars v1 uses a transparent backing beneath its glass image.

--ki-tooltip-bg-image.description: Optional CSS background image layered over the tooltip fill. Use none for a solid fill.

--ki-tooltip-border-color.description: color used by the tooltip component for its edge (MarsUI hairline bevel, Outline/secondary_button_top); one token so a mode or a theme can strengthen it.

--ki-tooltip-border-width.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for the bevel outline width (MarsUI glass card 1px Outline/secondary_button_top stroke; replaces the 1px literal ki-tooltip.css shipped while the token was pending).

--ki-tooltip-fg.description: color used by the tooltip component for foreground (MarsUI title row Text/high_em; lands together with the glass background — white-on-glass would break contrast).

--ki-tooltip-font-size.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for font size (MarsUI Heading_top style UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).

--ki-tooltip-font-weight.description: font weight used by the tooltip component for font weight.

--ki-tooltip-line-height.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).

--ki-tooltip-max-inline-size.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for max inline size (288px; the master card is fixed 280px wide in its rich variants — the 8px divergence is a documented text-only reduction).

--ki-tooltip-offset.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for offset (MarsUI caret depth 8px with zero extra gap = trigger-to-card distance).

--ki-tooltip-padding-block.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for padding block (MarsUI card padding Space/xl 12px on all sides).

--ki-tooltip-padding-inline.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for padding inline (MarsUI card padding Space/xl 12px on all sides).

--ki-tooltip-radius.description: dimension used by the tooltip component for radius (MarsUI Tooltip master 12089:7621 List_wrap: Radius/big_component/radius_xs 16px).

--ki-tooltip-rich-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-bg.description: Fill of the rich tooltip or rich popover.

--ki-tooltip-rich-bg-image.description: Optional image layer over the rich surface fill.

--ki-tooltip-rich-border-color.description: Outline ink of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-border-width.description: Outline thickness of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-fg.description: Ink of the rich surface body text.

--ki-tooltip-rich-font-size.description: Body text size of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-font-weight.description: Body text weight of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-heading-family.description: Typeface of the rich surface heading.

--ki-tooltip-rich-heading-fg.description: Ink of the rich surface heading over the shared fill.

--ki-tooltip-rich-heading-gap.description: Distance between the rich heading and its body.

--ki-tooltip-rich-heading-size.description: Text size of the rich surface heading.

--ki-tooltip-rich-heading-weight.description: Text weight of the rich surface heading.

--ki-tooltip-rich-line-height.description: Body text line height of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-max-width.description: Maximum inline size of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-padding-block.description: Block-axis inset of the rich surface, before density scaling.

--ki-tooltip-rich-padding-inline.description: Inline-axis inset of the rich surface, before density scaling.

--ki-tooltip-rich-radius.description: Corner radius of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-rich-shadow.description: Raised elevation of the rich surface.

--ki-tooltip-shadow.description: shadow used by the tooltip component for shadow (MarsUI Elevation/e4 on the master wrap).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

`for` and `heading` are provided. Rich tooltips accept text only.
